## Technical Corrections to This Historical Draft

This source is retained for audit history and is excluded from the production reading path. The corrections below govern its interpretation; the original wording is preserved separately.

The expression $\int L(x,u,t)\,dt$ alone does not imply the mechanical Euler–Lagrange equations. Those equations concern a mechanical Lagrangian $L(q,\dot q,t)$ and admissible variations of a configuration path with specified endpoint conditions. In optimal control, $L$ is instead a running cost and the state equation is an explicit constraint.

For a smooth, normal, fixed-final-time problem with fixed initial state, free terminal state, no state constraints and terminal cost $\phi(x(t_f))$, define $H=L+\lambda^T f$. With column gradients, necessary conditions include $\dot x=f$, $\dot\lambda=-\nabla_x H$ and $\lambda(t_f)=\nabla\phi(x(t_f))$. The control minimizes $H$ over its admissible set almost everywhere; $\nabla_u H=0$ applies to a differentiable interior minimizer. These conditions do not prove sufficiency. Endpoint constraints, free time and hybrid events require corresponding transversality or jump conditions.

This control Hamiltonian is not generally mechanical energy. See [the primary adjoint derivation](https://underactuated.mit.edu/trajopt.html) and [canonical control treatment](../../../tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-3-control.html).

Current reading path: [Canonical Series Article](/articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-6-hybrid.html).

## Introduction

The tangent-hyperplane and integral-superposition frameworks admit a natural
extension into Hamiltonian mechanics and adjoint sensitivity analysis.

## Action Functional

$$
\mathcal{S} = \int_{t_0}^{t_1} L(x,u,t)\,dt
$$

Stationarity of $\mathcal{S}$ yields the Euler–Lagrange equations.

## Hamiltonian Dynamics

$$
H(x,u,\lambda,t) = L(x,u,t) + \lambda^\top f(x,u)
$$

$$
\dot{\lambda} = -\frac{\partial H}{\partial x}
$$

## Interpretation

The costate integrates infinitesimal sensitivities backward in time.

:::
